summary: This annual survey covers activity from July 1, 2010, through June 30, 2011, and reports institution-level 12-month enrollment and instructional activity for undergraduate and graduate students. Its universe is postsecondary institutions eligible to report IPEDS enrollment data, with measures intended to capture institutions operating on nontraditional calendars or offering short-term programs. The tables distinguish students served over the year from the volume of instruction delivered, and instructional activity may be reported in credit hours, contact hours, or both.

Fall Enrollment covers postsecondary institutions reporting students enrolled in the fall. Traditional academic-year institutions report enrollment as of October 15 or their official fall reporting date; institutions with program-specific or continuous calendars report students enrolled at any time from August 1 through October 31. Records are institution-based, with multiple records per institution when enrollment is broken out by student characteristics; the applicable universe and eligibility can narrow for particular measures.

The annual Finance survey was collected in the winter 2011–12 reporting cycle and covers each institution’s fiscal year ending between July 1, 2010, and June 30, 2011. The unit of observation is the institution, and the universe is postsecondary institutions in the IPEDS universe that are open and required to report finance data. Institutions report revenues, expenditures, assets, and liabilities under the accounting basis applicable to their institution; the appropriate form depends on institutional control and accounting standard.

Graduation Rates reports the status of prior entering cohorts as of August 31, 2011, using 100%, 150%, and, in one table, 200% of normal time to measure completion or transfer. The unit of observation is the institution and its eligible cohort, with cohort-status records where applicable. The universe is full-time, first-time degree/certificate-seeking undergraduates, with institutional coverage varying by table across four-year, two-year, less-than-two-year, and less-than-four-year institutions.

These Human Resources tables report institution-level staff counts and, for selected instructional staff, salary outlays for Fall 2011 or the 2011-12 academic year. Fall measures generally use the institution’s payroll as of November 1, while academic-year salary measures cover the applicable contract period; each institution can have multiple records identified by table-specific classification fields. Coverage includes postsecondary institutions and related administrative offices, but degree-granting status, institution size, and staff-category eligibility vary by table.

The Institutional Characteristics survey was collected July 1–October 19, 2011, for the 2011–12 academic year. It covers IPEDS institutions/reporting units, including Title IV institutions for which IPEDS reporting is mandatory; institutions may report as parent or child campuses, and active-status and survey-applicability indicators are available.

This institution-level survey covers student financial aid awarded during the academic year from July 1, 2010, through June 30, 2011, for eligible Title IV postsecondary institutions. It reports undergraduate aid recipients, including full-time, first-time degree/certificate-seeking undergraduates and, for selected measures, all undergraduates. Student financial aid data are collected in odd-numbered years, so 2011 (odd) has data.
